The forge lays **blades** on the anvil by itself. Drag a blade onto the same one and you get one a level higher and much stronger. A double tap merges a blade with the nearest twin. A blade of another level swaps places, and the **sale chest** takes one for gold.

All blades cut the monster at the gate by themselves, each one drops **gold**. Every tenth wave is a **boss** with a timer: miss it and you fall back a wave and farm until you press «Try again». A tap on the forge speeds up the current blade.

With a record of wave 60 the **reforge** opens: everything goes into the fire, **coals** stay — each gives +5 % damage and gold forever, and coals buy the **Master's Forge**. Coals pay only for a better record. After 1 000 coals **Star metal** opens.

When the anvil is full, keep tapping: new blades without a free slot are sold at the normal price. Blades on the field and queued chest rewards are kept.

**Outpost:** after the first boss, recruit Bran or Veya and give them a real blade from the anvil. Pets and tempering unlock at wave 20; the dragon at wave 30. Prepare an ability, aim or occasionally intercept the approaching monster.

Reforging keeps heroes, XP, pets and absorbed dragon power. Weapons, tempers, the rack and undigested blades reset with the run. Anvil Memory also considers equipped weapons.

**Progression:** choose talents at hero ranks 3, 6 and 10. Eira and the raven unlock at record wave 40; Corvin and the turtle at 50. An adult dragon gains breath forms; molting requires a new record and spends absorbed power while keeping its age.

**Requests:** contracts unlock at wave 25, branching expeditions at 45 and separate forge trials at 60. Awarded mentor XP can train a recruited hero. Delivered blades are consumed at the quoted value. Trials use a separate board and never spend your real weapons.

Найден в канаве у ворот — с него всё и н: Found in the ditch by the gate — where it all began
Первый клинок кузни выковал не мастер, а: The forge’s first blade was made not by a smith but by the rain: the knife lay in the ditch by the gate all autumn. The apprentice scrubbed it with sand and laid it on the anvil, just so the anvil would not stand empty. The anvil remembered.
Зеленеет от обиды, если его не точить: Turns green with resentment if you do not sharpen it
Медь мягкая и обидчивая: стоит забыть ки: Copper is soft and touchy: leave the dagger in the damp for a night and by morning it is covered in green spots. The old smiths said it was sulking. Sharpen it more often and it shines again like a new coin.
Звенит, как колокол, когда рубит: Rings like a bell when it strikes
Бронзу льют, а не куют, но этот тесак вс: Bronze is cast, not forged, but this cleaver went under the hammer anyway — the master was stubborn. Now it answers every blow with a clear ring, and the rats in the cellar scatter before it even comes down.
Первый настоящий меч кузни, без затей: The forge’s first real sword, plain and simple
Ни узоров, ни камней — только честное же: No patterns, no gems — just honest iron and a straight blade. Swords like this were once handed out to the gate guards, one per watch. They say one still hangs over the hearth in the guardhouse and has never let anyone down.
Держит заточку дольше, чем хозяин держит: Holds its edge longer than its owner keeps a promise
Сталь вышла из горна, когда мастер вперв: The steel came out of the forge the first time the master fanned it to white heat. The blade turned out light and fierce: it cuts paper in mid-air and never dulls before the fight is over.
Удобен в тесноте: коридоры, подвалы, оче: Handy in tight spots: corridors, cellars, queues
Палаш выковали для конных разъездов, но: The broadsword was made for mounted patrols, but no horses were ever kept at the gate. It turned out, though, that in a narrow cellar with rats coming from every side a short blade is irreplaceable. Since then it has been called the rat sword — no offence meant.
Её заказал заезжий дуэлянт, который вызв: It was ordered by a travelling duellist who challenged the fog over the swamp and, by his own account, won. He never collected it — he rode off to find a worthier opponent. The blade stayed and has met every enemy with a graceful lunge ever since.
Пахнет полынью и дорожной пылью: Smells of wormwood and road dust
Его привезли купцы с востока, где степь: Merchants brought it from the east, where the steppe runs right up to the sky. The wind seems frozen in the curve of the blade: it is good for cutting at a gallop and awkward for everything else. The smith reforged it but kept the curve: the steppe does not forgive straight lines.
Длиннее, чем нужно, но ровно настолько,: Longer than needed, but exactly as long as you would like
Рыцарь, для которого его ковали, был рос: The knight it was forged for was as tall as a door frame and fond of dramatic poses. The sword outlived both the knight and his poses. Now it simply reaches enemies a step before they reach you.
Ни одноручный, ни двуручный — сам по себ: Neither one-handed nor two-handed — its own thing
Полуторный меч не знает, сколько рук у е: A hand-and-a-half sword does not know how many hands its owner has and does not worry about it. It was forged on a night when the forge roared so loudly the owls woke up. The owls are still offended; the sword is not.
Прошла через огонь, воду и ещё раз огонь: Through fire, water and fire again
Мастер окунал её в ледяную воду семь раз: The master plunged it into icy water seven times until the steel stopped hissing in indignation. Now the sabre bends almost into a ring and springs back with a ring of its own. The apprentices argue how many times it can be bent, but no one dares to check.
Требует обеих рук и всего уважения: Demands both hands and all your respect
Двуручник ковали втроём: один держал, дв: It took three to forge the greatsword: one held, two struck, and all three could not lift a spoon for a week afterwards. You do not fence with it — you plough the battlefield. They say if you stand it by the gate, enemies start behaving better on their own.
Волны на стали — память о каждом ударе м: Waves in the steel — the memory of every hammer blow
Узор появился сам: мастер сварил вместе: The pattern appeared by itself: the master welded soft and hard iron together and hammered them for a long time, folding the strip again and again. Waves remained on the blade like sand after the tide. You can count them — exactly as many as the times the master swore.
Свистит в полёте, будто насвистывает пес: Whistles in flight as if humming a tune
Ятаган ковали на вершине утёса, где вете: The yataghan was forged on top of a cliff, where the wind fanned the fire better than any bellows. The wind stayed in the steel: the blade whistles with every swing and, in calm weather, quietly whistles to itself. Nobody recognises the tune, but it is catchy.
Нечисть его не любит, а сороки обожают: Fiends dislike it, magpies adore it
Серебро плохо держит заточку, но хорошо: Silver holds an edge poorly but holds fear well: every fiend recoils from its gleam. The trouble is that magpies recoil the other way. The sword went missing from the forge three times and was found three times in a nest on the old pine.
Пришёл с северных гор вместе с волынкой: Came from the northern mountains along with the bagpipes
Клеймор привёз горец, который заплатил з: A highlander brought the claymore and paid for a night’s lodging with the sword and a song. The whole forge learned the song on the bagpipes, and everyone regrets it. The sword proved more generous than the song: huge, broad and surprisingly obedient in the hand.
Светится на рассвете, даже если рассвет: Glows at dawn, even when the dawn is cloudy
Его закалили в первом луче солнца, котор: It was tempered in the first ray of sun that broke through the forge window after the longest night of the year. Since then the blade glows pink and gold every morning. Night creatures dislike it — they dislike most things.
Не бликует в темноте — враг не видит, от: No glint in the dark — the enemy cannot see where the blow comes from
Чернение придумал ночной стражник, котор: Blackening was invented by a night guard who was tired of his sword’s gleam giving him away in ambushes. The blade was coated with a mix of sulphur and silver and turned dark as a pool. The guard was never caught — though, admittedly, there were no more ambushes.
Не остывает с тех пор, как вышел из горн: Has not cooled since it left the forge
Однажды горн разгорелся так, что палаш н: Once the forge burned so hot that the broadsword refused to come out. They pulled it out with tongs, and it kept burning. Now you can light a campfire with it, warm up supper and scare off swamp slimes — all in one swing.
Пахнет солью и немножко рыбой: Smells of salt and, a little, of fish
Его подняли со дна вместе с якорем затон: It was raised from the seabed together with the anchor of a sunken merchant ship. Patterns of seaweed remained on the steel, and if you hold the hilt to your ear you hear the quiet surf. The reforging did not wash the sea out of it, only added an edge.
Острее любой стали, хрупче любого стекла: Sharper than any steel, more fragile than any glass
Обсидиан родился в жерле вулкана и засты: Obsidian was born in a volcano’s mouth and set before it could fully cool — it is still warm to the touch. The smith did not forge it but chipped it, as the very first weaponsmiths did. The blade cuts everything and takes offence at everything, so handle it with care.
После удара оставляет в воздухе серый сл: Leaves a grey trail in the air after a blow
Клинок пепла выковали из того, что остал: The ash blade was forged from what remained after the great fire in the old forest. It is light as cinders and sheds sparks when it is angry. Ash wolves sense kinship in it and sometimes stop as if they wanted to ask something.
Режет только по ночам, днём делает вид,: Cuts only at night; by day it pretends to sleep
Серп ковали в полнолуние, и луна, говоря: The sickle was forged at full moon, and the moon, they say, watched through the window. By day it seems dull and sluggish, but as soon as the moon rises the blade fills with cold light. Gardeners dream of reaping with it; the smith will not let them.
Руны на клинке иногда меняются местами: The runes on the blade sometimes swap places
Руны на нём вырезал заезжий мудрец и уве: The runes were carved by a wandering sage who swore they spelled the word “victory”. A week later the runes rearranged themselves, and the sage now swore they spelled “lunch”. The sword was none the worse for it: it strikes equally well whatever the reading.
Становится тяжелее, когда наступает прил: Grows heavier when the tide comes in
Мастер поспорил с морем, что выкует клин: The master bet the sea that he would forge a blade that obeyed him. The sea agreed, on one condition: the blade would obey it too. Now it grows heavy at high tide and light at low tide — and it has never yet lost the bet.
Перед ударом коротко рокочет, как далёки: Rumbles briefly before a blow, like distant thunder
В кузню ударила молния, когда меч остыва: Lightning struck the forge while the sword was cooling on the anvil. The apprentices hid under the workbench, and the master said: “Finally, I have been waiting three hours.” Since then the blade crackles and smells of thunderstorms, and its owner’s hair stands on end.
Звенит от каждого прикосновения, даже от: Chimes at every touch, even at a glance
Хрусталь не куют, его уговаривают. Масте: Crystal is not forged, it is persuaded. The master sang over it for three nights until the stone agreed to become a blade. The sword is clear as spring water, and the enemy is reflected in it — usually for the last time.
Переливается зелёным и розовым, как небо: Shimmers green and pink like the sky at the edge of the world
Его выковал кузнец с самого северного ос: It was forged by a smith from the northernmost island, where the lights hang over the roofs every night. He caught a piece of the sky in a bucket of meltwater and quenched the steel in it. The blade still quietly shimmers and is cold as the polar night.
Не отбрасывает тени и не отражается в лу: Casts no shadow and has no reflection in puddles
Никто не помнит, кто его выковал, — даже: No one remembers who forged it — not even the forge itself. One morning the sword simply lay on the anvil, pale and quiet. It casts no shadow, and enemies say it strikes before it appears.
Выкован из звезды, упавшей прямо в горн: Forged from a star that fell straight into the forge
Однажды ночью звезда упала прямо в трубу: One night a star fell straight down the forge chimney and landed in the fire. The master did not lose his head and forged a blade from it before it cooled. So the star series began — and the master’s habit of glancing at the sky every evening.
Звёзды любят компанию: вторая пришла за: Stars like company: the second came after the first
Вторая звезда упала через год, точно в т: The second star fell a year later, in exactly the same place, as if looking for the first. The blade made of it is a little warmer and always points towards its elder brother. Lay them side by side and they hum softly in unison.
Светит так, что ночью при нём можно чита: Shines so bright you can read by it at night
Третий звёздный клинок оказался самым ра: The third star blade turned out the most talkative: it shines brighter when someone nearby is speaking. The apprentices read by it at night, and the master insists the blade simply loves stories.
Тёплый, как печка, и такой же уютный: Warm as a stove and just as cosy
Из четвёртой звезды вышел клинок, у кото: The fourth star made a blade that people warm themselves by in winter. The forge cat sleeps curled around its hilt and lets no one near. In battle, though, the blade forgets all about being cosy.
Пятый — на полпути к самой яркой звезде: The fifth — halfway to the brightest star
Пятый клинок звёздной серии отливает рыж: The fifth blade of the star series gleams reddish, like the setting sun. The master says the star got tired of falling and blushed a little. Enemies say otherwise, but not for long.
Поёт тонким голосом, когда рассекает воз: Sings in a thin voice as it cuts the air
Шестая звезда упала с песней — так говор: The sixth star fell singing — so says the shepherd who saw it from the hill. The blade inherited its voice: in battle it sings, high and clear. Singing along is not advised — the melody is different every time.
Седьмой: счастливое число, счастливый кл: The seventh: a lucky number, a lucky blade
Седьмую звезду мастер ждал, загадав жела: The master waited for the seventh star with a wish, and the blade came out lucky: blows seem to bounce off it on their own. The master will not say what the wish was, but he smiles.
Розовеет, как небо перед бурей: Turns pink like the sky before a storm
Восьмая звезда пролетела сквозь грозовую: The eighth star flew through a thundercloud and brought its pink glow with it. The blade is calm only in clear weather; before a storm it starts ringing softly. The village checks the weather by it more accurately than by aching knees.
Девять звёзд — и ни одна не похожа на др: Nine stars — and no two alike
Девятый клинок самый задумчивый: он медл: The ninth blade is the most thoughtful: it slowly changes colour as if remembering what its star was like. The master believes stars do not fall by chance but come to see what will be made of them.
Десятый — круглое число, но клинок остры: The tenth — a round number, but a sharp blade
К десятой звезде у кузни собралась вся д: The whole village gathered at the forge for the tenth star: they watched it fall, glow in the fire and become a blade. They celebrated until morning. The blade came out solemn and a little proud — deservedly.
Последний из клинков, которые помнит куз: The last of the blades the forge remembers
Одиннадцатая звезда упала тихо, без гром: The eleventh star fell quietly, without thunder or radiance, as if it knew the unknown would begin after it. This is where the blades the forge remembers come to an end. What comes next is up to the fire, the hammer and imagination.
